status: Post-result exploratory extension; rules fixed before computing new extension outputs; previous zero-hit results known
identity: Group only verified full source InChIKeys agreeing with SMILES-derived keys; retain unresolved entries as individual IDs. Do not merge on name, first InChIKey block, salt parent or tautomer alone. Canonical-tautomer groups are recorded separately as annotation, not merged in this analysis.
entity_score: Pool eligible original signatures by entity and cell, median within cell then median cells. Retain original eligible signature set and original measurement/query background. Exact duplicate sig_id forbidden. No expansion to newly eligible entries.
entity_inference: Reuse same 10000 matched gene-label null queries, recompute merged-entity scores at signature level, preserve singleton nulls. One-sided (1+exceedances)/10001; observed<=0 gets P=1; BH across all resulting operational entities including unresolved IDs. Entity p-values describe matched-set null only. Original candidate gate not relaxed.
entity_stability: Reuse original 1000 patient-bootstrap query draws and coverage flags; recompute merged-entity scores. Average tied ranks and 5th/95th rank percentiles; positive frequency denominator all planned draws; no top-k tie breaking for a new candidate decision.
multi_score: Same frozen 100-UP/90-DOWN signed query on same 978 landmarks: original gated weighted running-sum, negative cosine(query,z), negative Spearman(query,z) with average ties. Same within-cell then across-cell medians. Descriptive correlations, sign agreement, tie-inclusive top20 overlap only; no P values, consensus significance or new formal hits.
cardiac_multi_score: Same 897 common measured landmarks and mapped frozen query; negative cosine and negative Spearman of query with donor logFC, median donors, compared to original harmonized ES. Not a test of drug rescue.
toxicity: Use Hansen 2024 Supplementary Data 3 clinical cardiotoxicity classes only where exact source drug mapping is available. Unmapped drugs remain unknown/not classified by this source. These labels are historical source categories, not verified toxicity at current assay dose.
magnitude: For fixed 21 drugs use common all-gene intersection across existing expansion filters. RMS of equal-donor mean logFC primary; median absolute logFC sensitivity. Primary descriptive disease endpoint GSE237861 net reversal; report UP and DOWN as components, discovery and GSE141864 as context. No compound selection based on new results.
toxicity_analysis: Descriptive Spearman and leave-one-drug-out ranges, source-class medians and ranges; complete-case OLS standardized net reversal~source toxicity binary+standardized log RMS only if >=4 drugs per class and full rank. Report coefficients descriptively, no independent-drug P/CI because shared donors/controls and drug classes; no causal adjustment claim. Class omissions descriptive only.
disease_label_null: Design and feasibility only in this amendment. Do not execute before separately fixing exchangeability/covariates, full-pipeline null and empty-query rules. No switching nulls to obtain significance.
stop_rule: Do not promote candidate efficacy or infer absence of toxicity from null association; do not overwrite original scientific authority or frozen results. All outputs remain exploratory.
